searches.label: r2c6
searches.name: obs-sym, identity layout only
searches.hypothesis: This is the obs-symmetry net with the mask input and output maps cut to the identity layout alone. It tests whether, once the obs symmetries are hedged, the transposed and flipped action layouts still matter or just add interference (the 16-layout version collapsed to 0). If it scores 0, the actions use a non-identity layout and the 4-layout hedge is needed. If it beats 0.28, the extra layouts were noise.

searches.label: r4c5
searches.name: 16mb + gamma 0.95 + ent 0.005
searches.hypothesis: Candidate A with ent_coef raised from 0.002 to 0.005. Training success (about 0.87) trails dev, so a bit more exploration may stop the policy from fixing on wrong placement orders early. Refuted if dev is below about 0.86, i.e. extra entropy slows convergence within the short budget.

searches.label: r3c6
searches.name: kitchen sink, third residual block
searches.hypothesis: This adds a third residual block (dilation 1) with its own global context to the kitchen-sink net, so the trunk is deeper and can better infer landing heights and the effects of placement order. It costs some samples. It is refuted if dev success is no higher than about 0.22, i.e. not clearly above 0.15. Fix: LAYOUTS is now a literal list.

searches.label: r3c1
searches.name: LayerNorm scale-robust 16-layout
searches.hypothesis: This is the 16-layout hedge with separate 1x1 stems for obs and mask, each followed by a per-cell channel LayerNorm, plus LayerNorm in the trunk. The policy outputs start small (orthogonal init, gain 0.01). It targets obs channels on an unexpected scale, which would saturate the initial logits and stop exploration. Training success above 0 confirms a scale deviation. A 0 here and on the other LayerNorm candidates refutes it.

searches.label: r4c6
searches.name: r2c1 + entropy 0.005
searches.hypothesis: Same as r2c1, but ent_coef is 0.005, between the 0.002 that scored 0.41 and the 0.01 that scored 0.34. A little more exploration may stop the early collapse behind the 0 outcomes in close variants, without the waste seen at 0.01. Refuted if it scores clearly below 0.41.

searches.label: r4c3
searches.name: xflip lr3e-3, 16 minibatches
searches.hypothesis: r3c4 with n_minibatches raised from 8 to 16 (128 samples each), which doubles the gradient steps per update with no change in sample count. This targets optimisation speed within the fixed budget. It is refuted if it scores below about 0.81 or collapses, which would mean too many small steps destabilise PPO at lr 3e-3.

searches.label: r4c3
searches.name: yflip, ent 0.01 + global context
searches.hypothesis: Takes the best net (ent_coef 0.01) and adds a full-scale Linear projection of the pooled global features into every cell's head pre-activation. Placement logits can then use board-wide progress. The change costs almost no FLOPs and reached 0.86 training success at entropy 0.002, the highest at that setting. Dev above 0.92 supports it. Dev below 0.85 means the global term adds noise to local placement decisions.
